advancedProperties.value:
WITH TF0900CP_TAKEOVER AS ( 
SELECT 
  FK_TF0420CLIENT, 
  FK_TF0420ID_NUMBER,  
  SCOPE,  
  ACTION,  
  Q_SRV_REL_NO,  
  Q_RG_REL_NO,  
  Q_RATE_REL_NO 
FROM 
  TF0900CP, 
  META_PROCESS_CTRL 
WHERE 
  META_PROCESS_CTRL.PCTRL_PRC_SCOPE = '$$SESSIONNAME' 
  AND TF0900CP.LOAD_CYCLE_ID > META_PROCESS_CTRL.PCTRL_VRS_CTRL_NO 
GROUP BY 
  FK_TF0420CLIENT, 
  FK_TF0420ID_NUMBER,  
  SCOPE,  
  ACTION,  
  Q_SRV_REL_NO,  
  Q_RG_REL_NO,  
  Q_RATE_REL_NO 
), 
 
     TF0420CP_Q AS ( 
SELECT 
  TF0420CP.CLIENT AS CLIENT, 
  TF0420CP.ID_NUMBER AS ID_NUMBER, 
     
  ( CASE 
          WHEN ((VALID_FROM IS NULL) OR (VALID_FROM = '0001-01-01')) 
          THEN '0001-01-01' 
          ELSE TF0420CP.VALID_FROM - 1 YEAR 
          END 
  ) AS VALID_FROM, 
   
  ( CASE  
                WHEN ((TF0420CP.VALID_TO IS NULL) OR (TF0420CP.VALID_TO < TF0420CP.VALID_FROM)) 
          THEN ( CASE 
                      WHEN ((TF0420CP.VALID_FROM IS NULL) OR (YEAR(TF0420CP.VALID_FROM) = '9999')) 
                      THEN '9999-12-31' 
                      ELSE TF0420CP.VALID_FROM + 1 YEAR 
                      END 
          )   
          ELSE ( CASE 
                      WHEN ((TF0420CP.VALID_TO = '0001-01-01') OR (YEAR(TF0420CP.VALID_TO) = '9999')) 
                      THEN '9999-12-31' 
                      ELSE TF0420CP.VALID_TO + 1 YEAR 
                      END 
          ) 
          END  
  ) AS VALID_TO, 
   
  LOWER(TF0420CP.CREATOR) AS CREATOR, 
  TF0420CP.LOAD_CYCLE_ID AS LOAD_CYCLE_ID, 
  TF0420CP.ACTION_CODE AS ACTION_CODE, 
  TF0420CP.QUOTATION_TYPE AS QUOTATION_TYPE 
   
FROM 
  TF0420CP 
WHERE  
  (TF0420CP.CLIENT, TF0420CP.ID_NUMBER, VALID_FROM, TF0420CP.LOAD_CYCLE_ID) IN ( 
  SELECT CLIENT, ID_NUMBER, VALID_FROM, MAX(LOAD_CYCLE_ID)  
  FROM TF0420CP 
  GROUP BY CLIENT, ID_NUMBER, VALID_FROM 
  ) 
AND TF0420CP.ACTION_CODE <> 'D' 
), 
 
     TF0900CP_Q AS 
( 
SELECT 
 
  TF0900CP.RELATIVE_NUMBER,  
  TF0900CP.QUOT_NUMBER,  
  TF0900CP.QUOT_EDITION_NO,  
   
  MAX (TF0900CP.QUOT_EDITION_NO) OVER ( 
                                  PARTITION BY 
                                    TF0900CP.FK_TF0420CLIENT, 
                                    TF0900CP.FK_TF0420ID_NUMBER, 
                                    TF0900CP.SCOPE, 
                                    TF0900CP.ACTION, 
                                    TF0900CP.Q_SRV_REL_NO, 
                                    TF0900CP.Q_RG_REL_NO, 
                                    TF0900CP.Q_RATE_REL_NO ) as MAX_QUOT_EDITION_NO, 
    
  TF0900CP.NO_OF_SRV_IN_QUOT,  
  TF0900CP.NO_OF_RG_IN_QUOT,  
  TF0900CP.EXPECTED_VOLUME,  
  TF0900CP.EXPECTED_VOL_UOM,  
  TF0900CP.EXP_VOL_PERIOD_IND,  
  TF0900CP.STATUS_TIMESTAMP, 
   
  DATE (TO_DATE (TO_CHAR (STATUS_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) as STATUS_DATE, 
    
  TF0900CP.SCOPE,  
  TF0900CP.ACTION,  
  TF0900CP.TYPE,  
  TF0900CP.Q_SRV_REL_NO,  
  TF0900CP.Q_RG_REL_NO,  
  TF0900CP.Q_RATE_REL_NO,  
  TF0900CP.Q_RATE_CHARGE_CODE,  
  TF0900CP.T_RA_ID,  
  TF0900CP.T_SRV_REL_NO,  
  TF0900CP.T_RG_REL_NO,  
  TF0900CP.T_RATE_REL_NO,  
  TF0900CP.CUSTOMER_NAME,  
  TF0900CP.CUSTOMER_SUPPL,  
  TF0900CP.USER, 
  TF0900CP.USER_OFF_MC_N,  
  TF0900CP.USER_OFF_MC_S,  
  TF0900CP.RESP_OFF_MC_N,  
  TF0900CP.RESP_OFF_MC_S,  
  TF0900CP.SRT_LOCODE,  
  TF0900CP.BFR_LOCODE,  
  TF0900CP.BTO_LOCODE,  
  TF0900CP.END_LOCODE,  
  TF0900CP.QUOT_TIER,  
  TF0900CP.COMMODITY_GRP_CODE,  
  TF0900CP.COMMODITY_GRP_NO,  
  TF0900CP.COMMODITY_DESCR,  
  TF0900CP.RG_GROUP_CODE,  
  TF0900CP.RG_STD_GRP_NAME,  
  TF0900CP.CONT_TYPE_GROUP,  
  TF0900CP.QUOT_SOW,  
  TF0900CP.QUOT_NOR,  
  TF0900CP.QUOT_OOG_GENERAL,  
  TF0900CP.QUOT_DG,  
  TF0900CP.GL_NAME,  
  TF0900CP.GL_SEA_AMOUNT,  
  TF0900CP.GL_SEA_CURR, 
  TF0900CP.QUOT_SEA_AMOUNT,  
  TF0900CP.QUOT_SEA_CURR,  
  TF0900CP.Q_SEA_AMT_USD,  
  TF0900CP.Q_SEA_AMT_GL_CURR,  
  TF0900CP.GL_SEA_AMT_USD,  
  TF0900CP.GL_SEA_AMT_Q_CURR,  
  TF0900CP.DUR_QUOT_SNT_1ST,  
  TF0900CP.DUR_APP_REQ,  
  TF0900CP.FK_TF0420CLIENT,  
  TF0900CP.FK_TF0420ID_NUMBER,  
  TF0900CP.FK1TF0420ID_NUMBER,  
  TF0900CP.FK1TF0430RELATIVE,  
  TF0900CP.FK1TF0440RELATIVE,  
  TF0900CP.FK1TF0450REL_NUM,  
  TF0900CP.GL_SUB_NAME,  
  TF0900CP.LOAD_CYCLE_ID,  
  TF0900CP.ACTION_CODE, 
  TF0900CP.QUOT_VALID_FROM, 
  TF0900CP.QUOT_VALID_TO, 
  TF0900CP.GL_TOTAL_AMT_USD, 
  TF0900CP.Q_TOTAL_AMT_USD, 
  TF0900CP.Q_SEA_AMT_ORI, 
  TF0900CP.Q_SEA_AMT_USD_ORI, 
  TF0900CP.Q_SEA_AMT_GL_C_ORI, 
  TF0900CP.Q_RATE_TERM_NAME, 
  TF0900CP.Q_RATE_TERM_CODE, 
  TF0900CP.GL_RATE_TERM_NAME, 
  TF0900CP.GL_RATE_TERM_CODE, 
  TF0900CP.NEEDED_REASON, 
  TF0900CP.Q_RG_CL2_USD 
 
FROM 
  TF0900CP, 
  TF0900CP_TAKEOVER 
   
WHERE 
  TF0900CP.FK_TF0420CLIENT = TF0900CP_TAKEOVER.FK_TF0420CLIENT 
  AND TF0900CP.FK_TF0420ID_NUMBER = TF0900CP_TAKEOVER.FK_TF0420ID_NUMBER 
  AND TF0900CP.SCOPE = TF0900CP_TAKEOVER.SCOPE 
  AND TF0900CP.ACTION = TF0900CP_TAKEOVER.ACTION 
  AND TF0900CP.Q_SRV_REL_NO =  TF0900CP_TAKEOVER.Q_SRV_REL_NO 
  AND TF0900CP.Q_RG_REL_NO = TF0900CP_TAKEOVER.Q_RG_REL_NO 
  AND TF0900CP.Q_RATE_REL_NO = TF0900CP_TAKEOVER.Q_RATE_REL_NO 
) 
 
SELECT 
TF0900CP_Q.*, 
TF0420CP_Q.CREATOR, 
(	CASE 
	   WHEN TF0420CP_Q.QUOTATION_TYPE = 'C' THEN 'FIS' 
       WHEN TF0420CP_Q.QUOTATION_TYPE = 'W' THEN 'WEB' 
       WHEN TF0420CP_Q.QUOTATION_TYPE = 'V' THEN 'WCAS' 
       ELSE 'N/A' 
    END 
) as RAPP_QUOTATION_TYPE, 
TF0420CP_Q.VALID_FROM 
 
 
FROM 
 
TF0900CP_Q 
 
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
 
TF0420CP_Q 
   
ON 
  TF0900CP_Q.FK_TF0420CLIENT = TF0420CP_Q.CLIENT 
  AND TF0900CP_Q.FK_TF0420ID_NUMBER = TF0420CP_Q.ID_NUMBER  
  AND TF0900CP_Q.STATUS_DATE >= TF0420CP_Q.VALID_FROM 
  AND TF0900CP_Q.STATUS_DATE <= TF0420CP_Q.VALID_TO
